srList.sentence: Statistical analysis When data were consistent with a normal distribution and equal variances, means and standard deviations were calculated and comparisons of study variables among patients subgroups were carried out by One Way Analysis of Variance (ANOVA).

srList.sentence: Pairwise comparisons were performed by Holm-Sidak method when ANOVAs indicated a significant difference among subgroups.

srList.sentence: When deviation from a normal distribution was found, or when different var-iances were identified, medians and 25th-75th percentiles were calculated and comparisons were performed by Kruskal-Wallis One Way Analysis of Variance on Ranks (ANOVA on Ranks).
